title: aperture-mask — the photo seen only through one shaped window
idea: The photograph appears through a single arched window rising from the base of the band, with the headline sitting across it. The mask turns the image into an object with a silhouette instead of a rectangle of content.
why_new: no recipe gives the image a shape. This is the only way the generator could produce an arch, a portal or a slot.
built_from: one image inside a group carrying one of three reviewed mask shapes; the headline overlaps it in normal flow.
risk: contrast where the type crosses the aperture, and the shapes must be code-owned — a model-authored clip-path would produce a different silhouette every build.
